subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat streamed replies and continue-recent targeting

question: Should macOS Quick Chat adopt the expanded in-place transcript and recent-session picker once the correctness and proof blockers are resolved?
rationale: This is a new native workflow rather than a repair to an established contract, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit product acceptance after the mechanical defects are fixed.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped Quick Chat workflow
options.body: Keep the in-place transcript and session picker, contingent on the two repairs and convincing desktop proof.

options.title: Narrow to streamed replies only
options.body: Drop recent-session targeting if maintainers want Quick Chat to remain bound to the selected agent’s main session.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped Quick Chat workflow
recommendation.body: Keep the in-place transcript and session picker, contingent on the two repairs and convincing desktop proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current feature series and are the best available routing contact in the supplied evidence.
